d:
A fight broke out before the actual fight in Abu Dhabi. Former UFC bantamweight champion Merab Dvalishvili and PFL lightweight champion Usman Nurmagomedov were involved in a physical altercation that quickly escalated into a brawl between their respective camps.
But this confrontation has a history, rooted in Merab's rivalry with Usman's elder brother, Umar Nurmagomedov.
